purpose: Quick development-only test of whether a bounded supervised diagonal metric restores OI ranking under nuisance at competitive runtime.

methods.diagonal_unrefined: Train-fold-only supervised diagonal metric then current OverlapIndex with refinement=false.
methods.diagonal_refined: The same metric then current OverlapIndex with refinement=true.

diagonal_metric.between: sample-weighted variance of class means around the global mean
diagonal_metric.normalization: divide weights by their arithmetic mean
diagonal_metric.application: center by training global mean and multiply by sqrt(weight)
diagonal_metric.leakage_control: fit only on selector training-fold rows and apply unchanged to heldout rows

reference_heads.linear_scenarios: LogisticRegression on an independent 256/class reference train bank, evaluated on an independent 512/class test bank.
reference_heads.nonlinear_scenarios: 5-nearest-neighbor classifier on the same independent reference banks.

interpretation.runtime_claim: Toy runtime only; a real-shape timing anchor remains required.
interpretation.success_signal: Diagonal OI is within one point on linear nuisance, retains nonlinear OI ranking, and approaches probe runtime at the larger toy budget.
